## 更新 · What's new

- 中继新增独立的服务器访问密码；邀请二维码与短链接自动携带，扫码或粘贴即可加入。
  Relay adds a separate server access password, carried by invitation QR codes and links — scan or paste to join.
- 修复局域网刷新被缓存连接抑制的问题；改进 Mac 端 OCR、截图与窗口的内存释放。
  Fixes LAN refresh being suppressed by cached dial attempts; improves memory release for Mac OCR, screenshots and windows.
